Needs changes before merge.

Correction: my initial comment missed test inputs in the skip paths. A concurrent review identified this class of defect. I checked the source references below and agree with the blocker.

Requested before merge:
1. `.github/scripts/post-merge-skip.sh:25-26`: exclude test inputs from the docs-only skip rule. `README.md` is compiled into `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/structural/donate.rs:11`. Agent and site documents are read by `crates/app/tests/mcp_doc_drift.rs:15-20`. The recorded NC golden under `docs/tester-kits/sinumerik-810m-vmc200/` is read by `crates/app/tests/sinumerik_810m_post.rs:159-170`. Changes to these files can fail the gate. This rule skips that gate and its failure report. Use a rule that excludes all test inputs, and add tests for each excluded class.

Local results:
- Read the whole diff, issue #4054, and current upstream main's AGENTS.md.
- Local trial merge with main `83d52ef6a283497e00a1a13c8403ee4671cd7795`: clean. Verified that `HEAD^1` is the PR head. Main is already the PR's direct parent; the trial merge has the same files.
- Build, quick gate, tests, and clippy: not run. This PR changes `.github/` scripts and a workflow. The review rules prohibit execution of those files before maintainer inspection.
- The author reports 12 shell cases passed. I did not run them.
- Extra suites run: none. No import code or fixture files changed.
- Mutations: none. No machining implementation changed.
- Goldens moved: none. No UI files changed.

The maintainer must also inspect the three `.github/` files before execution. The blocker requires `needs-rework` first.

The local worktree and branch remain available for the next review.
A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 8075f1c8ab3eaaef3d5a1eee9648b9cd96664e16 -->
**Needs changes before merge.** This PR changes `.github/` only. Thus it is "read, not built", and the owner must also decide on the workflow change.

### What looks good

- Option 2 of #4054 is used, as the issue thread agreed. Each commit keeps its own run, and the run ends green-skipped with a notice.
- The `report` job already ignores a skipped run (`needs.gate.outputs.skipped != 'true'`). Thus a skipped docs run does not close the rolling "main is red" issue by mistake.
- `workflow_dispatch` always runs. `fetch-depth: 2` gives the first parent. For a PR merge commit, `HEAD^` is the previous `main`, so the diff contains all of the PR.
- A commit with no readable parent runs the gate (the `|| return 1` path).
- The scripts have provenance lines. The commit subject is conventional. The body has `Changelog: none` and `Fixes #4054`. This PR changes no process file, so it needs no `Process change: yes` line.

### Results

- Trial merge with `upstream/main` (`83d52ef6a`): clean. The PR head is already on the current main.
- Build and tests: not run. The PR changes only `.github/` files. The reviewer rules do not let the reviewer run a script that a PR adds or changes, so I did not run `test-post-merge-skip.sh`. No Rust code changed, so no cargo suite applies.
- Extra suites run: none. The diff does not touch `testdata/` or the importers.

### Requested before merge

1. **BLOCKER: the docs-only set contains files that batch-tier tests read.** File: `.github/scripts/post-merge-skip.sh:20-33` (`docs_only`). The notice says "no code changed - the previous run covers this code". That is not correct for these paths. A commit that changes only one of them can make `main` red. The run then skips, the report job does not run, and no "main is red" issue opens. Paths that the rule skips today, with the test that reads each one:
   - `README.md`: `include_str!` in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/structural/donate.rs:11`. This is in the `camcraft-ui` lib tests, so the file is a compile input.
   - `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`, `.agents/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`, `GEMINI.md`, `site/content/guide/automate/mcp.md`, `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md`: `crates/app/tests/mcp_doc_drift.rs:15-20` and `:91`, and `crates/app/tests/mcp_wire_contour.rs:362`.
   - `docs/tester-kits/sinumerik-810m-vmc200/` (`air_cut_vmc200.mpf`, `air_cut_vmc200.camproj`, `README.md`): `crates/app/tests/sinumerik_810m_post.rs:28`, `:159-170`. This is a recorded posted program in a post suite. A wrong-output suite must not skip.
   - `site/content/guide/automate/ai.md`: `crates/app/tests/ai_guide.rs:9`.
   - `site/content/guide/reference/troubleshooting.md`: `crates/app/tests/docs_troubleshooting.rs:93`.
   - `site/content/guide/getting-started/*.md`, `site/content/guide/check-and-post/machines.md`, `site/tests/test_guide_navigation.py`: `crates/app/tests/first_router_part.rs:290-367`.
   - `site/content/guide/operations/*.md` and `site/content/guide/multi-axis/*.md`: `xtask/src/catalog_links.rs:22-52`.
   - `examples/catalog/**/README.md` (through the `*.md` arm): `crates/app/tests/example_catalog/support.rs:95` and `xtask/src/catalog.rs:229`.

   Issue #4054 also says: "any commit touching code or build inputs runs the full gate as today". A file that a test reads is a build input of the gate.

   Fix: in `docs_only`, add a "run" arm before the skip arm for the paths that tests read. Example: `README.md | GEMINI.md | .agents/* | .claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/* | docs/agents/* | docs/tester-kits/* | site/content/* | site/tests/* | examples/*`. An alternative is a short allow-list of paths that no test reads (for example `docs/decisions/*`, `.claude/agents/*`, `.claude/skills/*` without `camcraft-mcp`, `AGENTS.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `RECOMMENDED.md`). The allow-list is safer when a new test starts to read a new docs file. Then add one `run` case for each new arm to `test-post-merge-skip.sh`. At minimum, add cases for `README.md`, `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` and `docs/tester-kits/x.mpf`.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)

- `*/build.rs` in the first arm has no effect at the moment: `crates/*` and `xtask/*` match first, and a `build.rs` outside those directories at a lower level is not in the tree. It is harmless.
- The owner must decide on the `.github/workflows/post-merge.yml` change (yellow `needs-maintainer` class). The label is `needs-rework` because of the blocker above. After the fix, the next review sets `needs-maintainer`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: the docs-only rule skipped files consumed by gate tests. The run arm now excludes root README/GEMINI, agent and MCP documentation, tester kits, site content/tests, and examples.

Pinned by the 17 new independent input cases in `.github/scripts/test-post-merge-skip.sh`. All 17 fail with the reviewed rule. All 29 cases pass with the fix. Bash syntax checks pass.

Head: `5872000a18cd9eac3566d82704b0f42b46370ff5`.
Quick gate against current upstream/main: green, 0 steps. Catalog: green, 1 step; 43 passed, 4 ignored. No goldens moved. Clippy and heavy lanes do not apply to this CI-only diff. The PR body has the commands and limits.

Please re-review. The PR remains a draft for maintainer inspection.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 5872000a18cd9eac3566d82704b0f42b46370ff5 -->
No blocking findings. Not built: needs a maintainer look at the three changed `.github/` files before execution. Set `needs-maintainer` and remove `needs-rework` because the previous blocker is fixed on this new head.

Previous findings:
1. Fixed by commit `5872000a18cd9eac3566d82704b0f42b46370ff5`. The skip rule included files that gate tests read. `.github/scripts/post-merge-skip.sh:27` now requires the gate for all input classes named in the previous review: root README and GEMINI, both MCP skill locations, agent documents, tester kits, site content and tests, and examples. This arm comes before the skip arm. I checked the test sources cited in the previous review.
2. The tests requested with that finding are present. `.github/scripts/test-post-merge-skip.sh:50-66` has 17 separate cases, one for each input path. Each case makes its own commit, so another changed file cannot hide a wrong skip result. The docs-only case now uses CONTRIBUTING.md instead of README.md.

Local inspection:
- Read the whole diff, the fix commit, issue #4054 and its comments, and current upstream main's AGENTS.md.
- Trial merge with upstream main `83d52ef6a283497e00a1a13c8403ee4671cd7795`: clean. Main is already an ancestor of the PR head. The local trial merge has the same tree as the PR head. Verified that HEAD^1 is `5872000a18cd9eac3566d82704b0f42b46370ff5`.
- `git diff --check upstream/main HEAD`: passed.
- The workflow passes the event name to the script. A manual dispatch bypasses the new docs-only check. The existing cut checks still apply. The report job excludes skipped runs.
- Build, quick gate, shell tests and clippy: not run. The PR-reviewer rules require read-only inspection for changed `.github/` scripts and workflows. No GitHub runner was used.
- Extra suites run: none. No test data, importer, post, operation, motion, catalog or UI files changed.
- Mutations: none run by this reviewer. This CI-only change does not change posted G-code, geometry, simulation, or collision and gouge checks.
- Author evidence, not independently run: 29 shell cases passed; all 17 new cases failed with the old rule and passed with the fix; Bash syntax checks passed; quick gate had 0 steps; example_catalog had 43 passed and 4 ignored.
- Goldens moved: none. UI screenshots do not apply.

Requested code changes: none. The maintainer must inspect `.github/scripts/post-merge-skip.sh`, `.github/scripts/test-post-merge-skip.sh`, and `.github/workflows/post-merge.yml` before execution. The review worktree and branch remain in place for the next round.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: the docs-only rule skips test inputs.

The held local fix adds gate-run exclusions for the paths in the latest review. It adds 17 shell cases.
The new cases cover the root README, MCP documents, tester kits, site content, site tests, and catalog READMEs.

Evidence on local head `af12882cf11e5af6067a4c20fc47b42ccf356388`:
- The shell suite passes all 29 cases. Both scripts pass `bash -n`.
- With the original skip script, all 17 new cases fail. With the fixed script, all 29 cases pass.
- The quick gate stops during tool compilation. A retry without sccache waits for the build directory lock.
- The example catalog attempt times out after 30 seconds on that lock. No Cargo test step runs.
- Clippy, heavy lanes, and UI screenshots do not apply to this `.github/` change.

RESULT: STOPPED warm worktree fix-4060 diverged from origin/issue/4054-post-merge-skip-docs.
Local-only commit: `af12882cf11e5af6067a4c20fc47b42ccf356388`.
Remote-only commit: `5872000a18cd9eac3566d82704b0f42b46370ff5`.

Another session pushed the remote commit during validation. I did not push, change the PR state, or replace its body.
The warm worktree and local commit remain in place. Please re-review the current remote head.
